page.content:
Warrant officer in a beret who later commands field missions.

How Flint connects

  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — Flint is a warrant officer and field leader of the G.I. Joe team.
  • Character: Lady Jaye — Lady Jaye and Flint are paired in the field and on the Sunbow show.

What is Flint?

Flint is Dashiell R. Faireborn, the airborne warrant officer whose beret, shotgun, and romance with Lady Jaye made him a second-wave field leader of the Joe team.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe team and Lady Jaye.
